is_not: a redesign of the R5 raw-freeze allowlist

defect_A_wrong_common_historical_baselin.finding: The evaluator preflight compared historical R1/R2/R3 artifacts against the single common baseline A5_STOP_HEAD. R1 artifacts were introduced after A5_STOP_HEAD (likewise R2 after R1, R3 after R2, R5 after R3), so git_blob(A5_STOP_HEAD, R1 artifact) = None while the artifact exists at its own freeze commit and at raw-freeze HEAD — the real repository evaluator preflight would falsely reject valid later-stage artifacts.
defect_A_wrong_common_historical_baselin.mechanical_confirmation: git_blob(A5_STOP_HEAD, evaluation/d4_a5_r1_result.json) = None; git_blob(R1_HEAD, same) = 285e657e9a90b9660c7e3bb30a0d59d86e0f9a4c; git_blob(HEAD, same) = 285e657e9a90b9660c7e3bb30a0d59d86e0f9a4c. None != real blob -> false drift.
defect_A_wrong_common_historical_baselin.repair: Per-stage historical artifact baselines: historical_artifact_baselines() maps A5_STOP_HEAD -> historical A5 first-attempt artifacts, R1_HEAD -> R1 preregistration/result/report, R2_HEAD -> R2 artifacts, R3_HEAD -> R3 artifacts, R5_HEAD -> R5 artifacts. historical_baseline_drift(project_root, head) fail-closes when an artifact is missing at its owning stage or differs at the checked head.

defect_B_incomplete_lineage_proof.finding: The evaluator preflight did not independently re-establish the complete implementation-freeze -> plan-freeze -> raw-freeze parent chain; manifest-recorded heads could be accepted without Git proof.
defect_B_incomplete_lineage_proof.repair: The preflight now mechanically proves, before outcome interpretation: implementation-freeze identity (exact R6 message, direct parent = R5_HEAD); plan-freeze identity (exact continuation plan-freeze message, direct parent = the implementation freeze); raw-freeze identity (exact raw-freeze message at current HEAD, direct parent = the plan-freeze); the strict R5 raw-freeze diff allowlist; raw-plan immutability; runner/test blob integrity; production/historical immutability; and cross-checks manifest-recorded heads against the Git-proven lineage (forged manifest values are rejected).
